title: GitHub code hosting is not GitHub model hosting
description: GitHub’s documentation reports that GitHub Models retired on July 30, 2026. Do not build new exercises around its inference endpoint. GitHub repositories and Copilot are separate products.
exercise: Inspect a public AI repository. Is it source code, an SDK, model weights, or a hosted service? Record the evidence before choosing it for a build.

title: Bring a key. Understand the boundary.
description: Your provider account and exact model determine access, data terms, quotas, and possible charges. The platform now offers temporary learner-key requests for Google AI Studio, Groq, and Cloudflare. A free account is not a guarantee of unlimited inference.
exercise: Use the provider worksheet from the library. Find your account’s actual quota and billing controls before making a request.

title: A workspace you can keep—not just a page you visited
description: Course workspaces can be downloaded as self-contained HTML. Lessons, notes, checklists, and the knowledge check work offline. Cloud inference does not. Download an updated copy to preserve edits, then export JSON to import progress back into the platform.
exercise: Download one course workspace, disconnect from the internet, change a note, save an updated HTML copy, and reopen it. Confirm the note survived.
